common: Use case: stylized-concept. Production anime game guard-break sprite strip, EXACTLY FOUR fully isolated full-body frames evenly spaced LEFT-TO-RIGHT in ONE ROW, wide1536x512 canvas, invisible equal384x512 cells. Input image is costume/anatomy/line-style reference. Select ONLY the named character. Match slender head, torso and limb proportions of that reference exactly in all4frames, no enlargement or stocky redesign. Same body scale in all4frames. Every figure faces screenRIGHT. Full feet on shared local baseline450, rootcenter192; ample margins. Keep whole body and weapon inside own cell. Restrained readable physical guard break: frame0 defensive forearms close to chest just as incoming contact disrupts guard; frame1 arms separate slightly, shoulders recoil20degrees, front foot slides half a step; frame2 small stagger, knees flex, guard lowered and shoulders slumped; frame3 recover balance, head dips and hands regroup close to torso. Both soles remain grounded except briefly lifted front heel, NEVER airborne. No extreme leaning, flailing, screaming, comically shocked expression, flying backwards, somersault, starburst, aura, impact lines or effects. Emotion: pained focus, restrained surprise. SOLID PERFECTLY FLAT CHROMA MAGENTA #FF00FF background, no gradients, floor, shadow, checkerboard, text or labels. Detailed small cel-shaded anime game sprites, clean dark ink, restrained shading. Anatomical hypothetical upright height280pixels, consistent head dimensions across allposes.

subjects.sakura: ONLY Sakura Haruno original-series outfit, long pink hair, red sleeveless tunic with white circle marks, white shorts, navy sandals. Match slender reference. One small lowered kunai, no sword.
subjects.zabuza: ONLY Zabuza Momochi, short black hair and headband, mouth bandages, bare lean muscular torso with dark strap, dark loose trousers, white-gray arm and calf wraps, navy sandals. Executioner cleaver rests low behind the body, retain broad squared blade and round hole; do NOT enlarge head/torso to fit sword. Upper forearm blocks while cleaver stays lowered.
subjects.haku: ONLY Haku, white hunter mask with red markings, dark hair tied back, teal tunic with cream edging and sash, brown underskirt, navy trousers, shin wraps and sandals. Mask stays on face. Empty hands or fine small senbon, absolutely NO sword or cleaver.

cinematic:
Use case: stylized-concept. Production anime videogame cinematic reaction sprite atlas. Use attached SIX-character idle reference image for exact costume, identity, slender anatomical proportions and clean cel-shaded ink style. EXACTLY TWENTY isolated full-body sprites in FOUR columns by FIVE rows. Each row depicts ONLY the specified character in four subtle related poses. Desired2048x1920 canvas, equal512x384 cells. Every full figure faces RIGHT, whole body and hands/feet fit each cell. Do not change body scale between the fourframes of a row. Keep same head/torso/limb dimensions as the reference anatomy. Kneeling naturally becomes shorter; never scale kneeling figures up to standing height. Feet/knees touch a shared invisible localbaseline320, centered256. Generous space between figures.
ROW1 TOP: ONLY Kakashi, silver hair, navy mask, green flak vest, slim adult body. Exhausted restrained standing reaction: lowered shoulders and hands resting near thighs; small head dip; one hand gently grasps opposite upper arm; same tired posture with eyes lifted slightly. Keep reserve and subtlety; no wide arm flailing, no dramatic gasp, no comical shock.
ROW2: ONLY Naruto, orange jumpsuit blue shoulders and creamcollar, blue headband, blond spikes. Kneeling grief and quiet surprise: both knees planted, sitting back on heels, hands loosely on thighs, eyes lowered; chin dips in grief; head turns slightly right with quietly widened eyes; hand resting lightly at chest and eyes up, subdued surprise. No crying cartoon mouth, no exaggerated gestures.
ROW3: ONLY Sakura, long pink hair, red sleeveless original tunic, white shorts, blue sandals. Kneeling attentive worry: both knees planted with hands resting on thighs; gentle forward lean; one hand lightly lifts to collar; shoulders settle with head bowed. Restrained compassionate expression, no extreme shock.
ROW4: ONLY Haku, dark tied back hair, white red-marked hunter mask still ON face, teal cream-trimmed tunic, brownunderskirt, navy trousers/wraps/sandals. Weary standing: shoulders droop and hands lowered; slight head dip; one hand touches forearm; head lifts weakly. No sword, no cleaver, no other weapons.
ROW5 BOTTOM: ONLY Zabuza, short black hair and headband, mouth bandages, bare lean muscular torso with narrow darkstrap, darktrousers and wraps/sandals. Injured standing: slightly hunched, right hand supports left ribs, other arm hangs; knees bend slightly; one small staggering foot step; settle into guarded injured lean. Tiny restrained scuff marks, NO blood, no openwounds, no gore. NO sword in this injured cinematic set.
BACKGROUND is solid flat PERFECT CHROMA KEY MAGENTA #FF00FF. No gradients/checkerboard/shadow/floor/VFX/text/labels/grid. Never enlarge heads or torsos for emotion. Same detailed small anime videogame rendering as reference, modest contrast and crisp edges. Absolutely20 figures, exactly4perrow, exactly5rows.
